{{Quote|But I am Mat Rags, the greatest hunter the galaxy has ever known!|Mat Rags to [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Mat Rags''' was a male [[Human/Legends|Human]] from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], living on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the time of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]]. He still resided there during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Mat Rags came to [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] to hunt [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragons]], claiming he was the greatest beast hunter in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
During his time in Mos Espa, Rags ran into [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who was trying to purchase a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] generator. Such was Qui-Gon's kindness towards the rugged Mat Rags, the hunter gave the Jedi a rare krayt dragon tooth as a souvenir.
{{Endgame}}

[[File:VosAndRags.png|thumb|left|200px|Rags in [[Akim's Munch/Legends|Akim's Munch]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]]]

During the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]], Rags worked as a [[Podracing/Legends|podracer]] mechanic to earn a living. His sport of dragon hunting was not frequent enough to pay well.

During the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Mat Rags still lived in Mos Espa, helping locals train to become worthy hunters. He wore a krayt dragon's claw around his neck, as a show of his status as a hunter. He continued to boast about his greatest kills, a wild [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] being one of them. His bragging annoyed those who knew him.

[[File:MatRagsGCW.jpg|thumb|200px|Mat Rags during the Galactic Civil War]]

During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] asked him for a [[Squill (creature)|squill]] carcass so that they could harvest its meat. Mat Rags, seeing this as an excellent training opportunity, tasked an aspiring hunter with finding and killing a squill. The [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] succeeded, and Mat Rags saw to it that the carcass was given to the Jawas. Mat Rags was happy with the spacer, but the work was not over. Mat Rags soon learned that an offworlder desired the hide of a variegated [[Womp rat/Legends|womp rat]], so that he could take it back home as a trophy. Though Mat could not fathom why someone would want such a hide, he tasked the aspiring hunter with killing the beast.<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

Mat Rags was offered yet another commission for a [[Matriarch/Legends|matriarch]] [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] trophy. Mat Rags, feeling as though such a task was beneath his skills as a hunter, once again tasked the novice hunter with finding and killing the creature. The spacer boasted that the bantha could be hunted blindfolded, and with both hands tied behind the back. Though the spacer did no such thing, the bantha was nonetheless killed. Mat Rags was impressed, but he had one final, more challenging task for the spacer. A museum desired a stuffed [[Dewback/Legends|dewback]] to display in a dangerous wildlife exhibit. The spacer agreed, and hunted down a grizzled dewback. The hide was brought back in good condition, as requested, so that it could be properly displayed. Mat Rags was quite impressed with the spacer, but lamented the fact that the League was not accepting new applicants. Nonetheless, Mat Rags awarded the spacer [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and a master hunter trophy. The trophy was a [[Bol]] skull from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], given to members of the Hunters guild that proved themselves as skilled hunters.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mat Rags was voiced by [[Gregg Berger]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]. The player, in the guise of Jinn, has the option of talking to Rags and may acquire a dragon tooth. This article assumes the player does so. The tooth may then be traded in Mos Espa for a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].

Mat Rags appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, players may perform a series of quests for him which involve hunting various creatures. The game depicts Mat Rags to be bald, but with [[Color/Legends|brown]] eyes, which is contrary to other sources, which show him to have blue eyes.
